subject.title: feat: MCP Apps (ui://) Phase 0 — generic host in Control UI + plugin-declared MCP servers

question: Should OpenClaw own a distinct MCP Apps sandbox-origin deployment contract and the native plugin `mcpServers` API in this phase?
rationale: The patch cannot safely meet the stable web-host contract on its current same-origin route, while both the isolated origin and manifest field establish long-lived product, security, deployment, and compatibility contracts that tests cannot choose.

options.title: Own Both Contracts
options.body: Implement and document the isolated origin, prove its browser behavior, and explicitly approve the native manifest API before merge.

options.title: Narrow Phase 0
options.body: Remove stable conformance claims and `mcpServers`, retaining only a smaller explicitly experimental host surface.

options.title: Defer The Feature
options.body: Pause the PR until sandbox deployment ownership and the plugin API direction are ready.

recommendation.title: Own Both Contracts
recommendation.body: Implement and document the isolated origin, prove its browser behavior, and explicitly approve the native manifest API before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the requested reviewer, the decision owner named in the discussion, and the strongest current-main history match for the affected surfaces.
